[quote=united_hydronia;60047091][spoiler=[b]Mainland operations[/b]]
The kaiserreich JDAMs, although clearly very advanced, would fall victim to Hydronia's jamming units and other EW capabilities for a variety of reasons. Frequency hopping is an unviable option for JDAM GPS systems, due to the limited amount of frequencies that GPS can operate on. The Hydronian jamming units can easily block all three GPS frequencies (L1, L2 and L5). With GPS disabled, the INS would begin to drift over longer distances, greatly reducing their accuracy. If the JDAMs did manage to find their way to their targets with any degree of accuracy, they would be easily shot down by Hydronia's laser-homing man portable missiles.

The enemy missile's High-G maneuvers would not be enough to shake the Hydronian missiles. Laser-homing would allow for a quick and accurate lock on the enemy missiles. This lock could then easily be kept due to lasers moving at the speed of light, allowing the missiles to receive data on the enemy's movements quickly and react accordingly. High speeds would also not prove effective, due to the before mentioned nature of lasers, providing Hydronia's missiles with the highest accuracy. The kaiserreich's ECMs would be ineffective against lasers and waste of time. Spoofing the missiles' lasers would be very difficult without a physical decoy. Since electronic spoofing doesn't produce a physical surface for the laser to bounce off of, the missiles wouldn't be deceived and would continue towards their targets. The kaiserreich jets' last line of defence, directed energy weapons would be effective, but only on a small scale. The energy weapons couldn't target and destroy every interceptor that the Hydronians deployed. Even if they could, it would provide the Hydronians with enough time to escape and regroup. If the enemy missiles managed to survive the interceptors, the Hydronian aircraft would be well on their way to regroup. The kaiserreich's data on Hydronian aircraft would be limited due to only having one other air engagement with them, over the skies of Nestorstaat. They would be ineffective in predicting the Hydronian's evasive maneuvers, further providing the aircraft with time to escape. Once the aircraft regrouped with the now 200 other aircraft in the sky, they would be easily able to defend themselves. Huge numbers of the interceptors could be fired as needed against the Kaiserreich missiles. It would be near impossible for them to survive.

The drones may have survived Hydronia's drone swarm attack, but the effectiveness of them would be thrown into question. It would be impossible for the drones to search across an entire country, especially noting Hydronia's size. The locations of every unit would be impossible to gather, due to camoflauge measures routinely used by the Hydronian army. Methods such as infrared would have more success, but Hydronian snipers would easily be able to shoot down the drones. A military-grade drone with enough firepower to cause serious damage would be heavy and bulky. This would slow it down and provide an easy target for Hydronia's well trained snipers. However, five travelling units would be outplayed by the drones, being bombed by them. The donnerkeils would be dealt with through a combination of chaff, jamming and flares.

The long-range enemy torpedoes had failed to account for one key point, Pressure. Every ~10m of depth increases the pressure by an extra ~1 atmosphere. The Hydronian submarines would be far more pressure-resistant than small torpedoes. By diving below maximum operational depth, the submarines would escape whilst the torpedoes would be slowly crushed behind them, removing the need to expend anymore ATTS. The UUVs would also suffer the same fate as the torpedoes. The submarines, now diving well below their safety limits would be safe from the UUVs being squashed under pressure. Even if the torpedoes and UUVs survived the pressure, the water density would cause their accuracy to falter, most likely causing them to sail straight past the submarines. The sonobuoys would be dealt with through a combination of torpedoes and electronic countermeasures. The submarines would fire a small amount of torpedoes to conserve their supplies. The hope would be to destroy the sonobuoys. If the torpedoes failed, jamming would ensure that the data collected by the sonobuoys could not be transmitted back to the Kaiserreich fleet.

C-RAM attached to armoured vehicles would attempt to cover the troops from artillery fire as they made their retreat to higher ground. The aim would be to intercept the artillery shells before they could release their submunitions. The C-RAM would also provide cover from the tank shells. Mobile Jamming units would be employed to disrupt the JDAMs GPS signals, causing their accuracy to deviate. The Hydronians would most likely have enough time to get out of the vicinity of the JDAMs, as well as inaccuracies due to lack of GPS. Otokar cobra I APCs bought from Indonocaismnic also help to provide cover, maintaining constant fire on the enemy troops and vehicles. Hydronias own cheap suicide drones would be put to use against the enemy drones. Released from trucks and ground-based launch pads behind the frontline, They would swarm around the enemy drones, distracting them from their targets. They would also be packed with cheap explosives, which would detonate upon crashing into enemy drones. Most Hydronian soldiers had already boarded the armoured vehicles, providing cover from the IFV fire.

Sniper fire may have failed, but Hydronia had more tricks up its sleeve. The versatile mobile jamming units would be used to disrupt the drones signals connecting them to the operator. The paratroopers couldnt use the drones if they couldnt talk to them. Additionally, the Kaiserreichs own use of red phosphorus smoke would hinder their drones efforts. Mere minutes would be enough time for the highly skilled Hydronian soldiers to vacate the vicinity of the JDAMs. After the first team fell victim to the bombs, the Hydronians quickly learned from their mistakes. They would make themselves seen by the paratroopers, causing them to call in the JDAMs, but by the time they had done so, The Hydronians were already escaping. Inaccurate guidance caused by GPS jamming would also cause the JDAMs to begin to deviate, further buying time for the Hydronians. The Red phosphorus smoke would hinder the paratroopers own efforts to vacate the JDAMs  target site. The Kaiserreich would be killing their own troops.

The gunslingers would be dealt with through the use of the same interceptor missiles as before. Their high-accuracy laser homing would soon lock onto the enemy missiles. This lock would be firm, only ridiculous and dangerous manoeuvres would shake them. The sheer number of these interceptors, being launched from at least 50 aircraft would ensure that they could not all be destroyed by the Kaiserreichs energy weapons. Once the gunslingers were destroyed, the jets would then move on to taking out the systems that launched them. Barrages of air-to-surface missiles would be launched, using infrared to home in on troops and launchers. The jets would now get to taking on the second layer. Air-to-surface missiles designed for long-range strikes would have a range far greater than that of the enemy SAMs, built for defensive purposes. The Hydronian strikes would have a range of up to 100km, allowing them to see and strike the SAMs and their radars using infrared before they had time to react. Even if the SAMs had time to target the missiles and fire, the sheer number of missiles would again come to Hydronias advantage, making it highly improbable that all missiles could be intercepted. The third layer of defences would be easy. The range of air-to-surface missiles would once again outdo the kaiserreich defences. The missiles have a maximum range of 100km, gatling guns couldn't match that. Again, rounds of laser-homing missiles would be fired, not all of them could be intercepted. The MANPADS would prove to be the greatest challenge. The front-running jets would take direct hits, but the helicopters, staying within a defensive formation, would be safe. A change of tactic would be required to deal with this threat, a risky one too. Flares could be used against the MANPADS, but only the attack helicopters possessed such capabilities. The helicopters would now take the lead on the attack, using their flares as a decoy, to lure the MANPADS away from the engine heat of the helicopters. If these failed, interceptor missiles would be used to take down the MANPAD missiles. The gunslingers had failed once before, and they would do again. laser-homing interceptors would again be launched in numbers to take on the enemy missiles, producing the same effects described earlier. Three more jets would be hit, but this would be but a pinprick to the aerial counterattack. Once the missiles were dealt with, the jets could easily take out the UAVs. Air-to-air missiles using infrared would easily see the vehicles and rocket towards them. The hastily put together air defences would prove no match for the powerful Hydronian counteroffensive. The armada of aircraft would now split into two groups. The first group, comprised of attack helicopters and jets, would begin taking out key enemy targets. The attack helicopters would use air-to-surface missiles to carry out precision strikes on radar, fuel tankers, air defence systems, captured transport links and other critical infrastructure in the kaiserreich's captured territory. The jets of the group would begin a brutal carpet bombing campaign across the territory, using high-yield gravity bombs. Nowhere would be safe. The second group would begin taking out targets in the sky. Air-to-air infrared homing missiles would be sent towards the J-16 and J-15Es, whilst laser-homing interceptors would be put on the ready for the enemy's resistance. At least 2 jets would target a single enemy jet at once, ensuring that numbers are on Hydronia's side.

Point defence systems would be key targets for Hydronia's precision strikes. Whilst the first round of artillery would be intercepted, the rounds that followed would be able to sail through the air into reichswehr controlled territory without resistance. Additionally, surface-to-surface missiles would be launched from man-portable missile launchers. The JDAMs would be dealt with using Hydronia's same old tactics of jamming. Portable jamming units would be able to disable the JDAMs GPS, whilst surface-to-air interceptors would attack the JDAMs. Their INS would drift over the long distance. The drift may not affect large industrial targets, but small units of men on the ground would easily have time to escape. Howitzers would cause heavy casualties despite Hydronian troops hiding behind hills to protect themselves, but the kaiserreich troops wouldn't be safe either. The continuing carpet bombing, artillery fire and surface-to-surface bombardment would be sure to inflict casualties. Suicide drones would be annoying to deal with. Their cheapness and high speed made the quite effective, but they would be prone to jamming. Hydronia's portable jamming units would cut off the drones from their operators, causing them to drop to the ground, where they could easily be dealt with. Hydronian numbers would rapidly increase, bringing total troop numbers up to ~100,000. This, combined with an abundance of armoured vehicles and tanks would begin to provide resistance to the reichswehr and push them back, although the primary purpose of these troop deployments were to hold their ground until karcovian help could arrive.

Away from the frontlines, in Seraphar, the state capital of Lumir, a total of 50,000 troops have been deployed, with more on their way. They will stand as a backup, in case the frontlines fail and the reichswehr reach the urban area.
[/spoiler]

[spoiler=[b]underwater stealth[/b]]
The stealth submarine would now be less than a day away from the Kaiserreich fleet, where they would fire hell at them from below.
[/spoiler]

[spoiler=[b]Peace negotiations[/b]]
The government of Hydronia has issued an official request to [nation]Dhornaper[/nation] for possible peace talks to be held in the neutral country. The government awaits a response from The kaiserreich and the possible host of the peace talks. Hydronia has also proposed a ceacefire during the negotiations.
[/spoiler]

[spoiler=[b]Last Stages of Operations in Hydronia[/b]]The JDAMs continue to accurately target Hydronian oil infrastructure and transport infrastructure. Other guidance modes feed into the bombs guidance systems including laser designation and alternate navigation aids including terrain matching. While the jamming systems of Hydronia only cover L1, L2 and L5, the Kaiserreich uses M-code signals to null out the jamming sources. Use of alternate guidance and M-code allows the JDAMs to remain highly accurate in the face of ineffective Hydronian jamming. At the last stage, the Hydronians use laser homing missiles against the JDAMs. This isnt practical for several reasons. Laser homing requires the missile to lock onto a laser spot reflected from the target. The JDAM isnt painting a laser or distinct trackable laser signature while it's dropping. The small size, high speed and limited exposure time makes a laser lock on that much more improbable. The laser target isnt stable or continuous on JDAMs making interception with laser homing man portables very improbable and difficult. 

The Hydronian laser homing missiles would be highly ineffective again while used against the Gunslinger supersonic air to air missiles. Laser-homing requires a laser painted onto the target which is viable on slower moving vehicles. However, a supersonic and highly maneuverable missile would be nearly impossible to hold the laser spot onto. Supersonic AAMs can close the gap at extremely high speeds making it very hard to even react in time. Laser designation, missile launch and terminal guidance would all take a longer time than for the AAMs to reach the Hydronian jets. Hydronian jets wouldnt have the time to regroup as their laser homing interceptors fail to lock onto the missiles and the Gunslingers fly towards them. Gunslinger prediction methods would be solid with data not just from Nestorstaat but the multiple air engagements over Hydronian skies. Firing huge numbers of ineffective laser homing missiles, dependent on laser painting that is infeasible with supersonic and maneuvering missiles would just be a massive waste. 

The Donnerkeils easily bypass chaff, flares and jamming. Chaff effects on the cruise missile would be minimal as it doesnt utilize radar for terminal navigation. Using primarily GPS, INS, TERCOM and DSMAC that are passive and dont emit radar signals and are thus not confused by chaff. On jamming, the CRPAs onboard focus GPS emissions on the correct sources and work to null out Hydronian jamming to maintain constant GPS feeds. Even in the rare occasion that jamming does work the missile doesnt require mid-flight intervention due to pre-programmed routes. Flares have absolutely no effect on the missile since it doesnt use infrared tracking. 

The Reichswehr torpedoes are able to chase as deep as over 800 meters. Usually submarines hull crush points are above this limit(Virginia-class: ~600m). The torpedoes and UUVs are able to continue to chase the submarines without being crushed for several reasons. Smaller structures such as the UUVs and torpedoes experience fewer total pressure-induced stresses than larger submarines due to less surface area for pressure to act on. Unlike the submarines the smaller UUVs and torpedoes also dont need air systems, large cavities or complex internal compartments allowing them to structurally reinforce better for high pressure. The titanium casing also allows it to survive in high pressure environments. For these reasons the torpedoes and UUV swarms continue to chase the submarines even as they dive deeper. 

The Kaiserreichs artillery batteries utilize MRSI to cause multiple rounds to impact at the same time with the purpose of saturating the C-RAM defenses. Due to being fired at high-arcing trajectories the shells are able to descend at almost vertical rates to overwhelm C-RAMs with limited elevation coverage. Used against C-RAMs that typically fire towards lower-angle threats, these exploit blind spots in coverage. To degrade the C-RAMs ability to defend the troops, the Reichswehr jams frequencies utilized by the C-RAM along with utilizing spoofing to create multiple false targets. Multiple Reichswehr batteries fire GMLRS towards the C-RAMs in a kinetic strike following EW attacks to destroy the air defenses permanently. Reichswehr tanks fire their DU tipped rounds towards the APCs and Hydronian armored vehicles while aided by man-portable missiles and air to ground anti-armor missiles guided via laser painting. At long-range the Reichswehr THOR system fires high powered microwaves towards the approaching drone swarms to fry their electronics and make them fall harmlessly out of the sky. 

Mobile jamming would have little effect on the paratroopers' drones. The fire and forget systems dont require human input for the drones autonomous systems to carry out their missions. They continue to carry out their suicide attacks on Hydronian armored vehicles and personnel. Line-of-sight capabilities of the drones wouldnt be hindered as they would move past the phosphorous before attacking the Hydronians. The JDAMs continue to maintain their accuracy through M-code signals and terrain matching. The few seconds the Hydronians have to get away wouldnt be enough to avoid the airstrike. 

The Gunslingers continue to strike Hydronian aircraft as laser homing a supersonic maneuvering air-to-air missile doesnt make practical sense. Saturation through launching massive numbers of laser homing missiles wouldnt be effective but rather a waste since laser painting these supersonic missiles consistently just isnt possible. The ineffectiveness of laser homing against these missiles would likely mean a significant chunk of the 200 aircraft and helicopters would be destroyed. Even if stragglers try to destroy the SAMs with supposedly longer air to ground missile ranges this doesnt prove to work. The 100 km range of the air to ground missile is outmatched by the 160 km range of the FAS-3 giving the Reichswehr significant time to intercept the large wave of aircraft before they get close enough. With range on the Reichswehrs side, coupled with large stockpiles of interceptors brought in via Regent sealift the saturation attacks would prove not only a blunder but a waste. At the MANPAD stage flares wouldnt prove helpful to the Hydronians. The dual banded IR systems of the man portable missiles along with imaging infrared seekers would help the missiles keep a lock on the incoming helicopters. The laser homing missiles wouldnt be effective against the Gunslingers as previously described, with the UAVs continuing to fire at the remainder of the wave at before visual range. The wave of aircraft likely wouldnt be able to reach Reichswehr controlled territory due to the ineffectiveness of their laser homing missiles and being outranged by the FAS-3. 

The precision assaults and carpet bombing on the Reichswehr point defense would be dependent on the Hydronian air wave being able to break through which it wouldnt(doesnt outrange and laser homing doesnt work well on the interceptors). The man-portable missiles would be dealt with the SHORAD rocket systems which take them out before they are able to hit the point defense. Hydronian jamming would be bypassed using the M-coded system and others described above allowing the JDAMs to accurately track down industrial sites and small groups of personnel. The fire and forget nature of the suicide drones makes them impervious to jamming as they are autonomous systems allowing them to continue their attack. 

Before the ceasefire is adopted the Reichswehr launches yet another assault on Hydronian infrastructure. B-25ELs are dispatched to drop JDAMs onto strategic factories, ports, railroads, bridges and command centers. GBU-57s are dropped from a different group of B-25ELs onto various Hydronian nuclear sites ranging from nuclear enrichment facilities to missile silos to set back THEPs nuclear programs. Two Seewolf-class submarines launch a wave of 300 Donnerkeil cruise missiles into Hydronian territory to destroy even more infrastructure, mostly against the already targeted oil infrastructure in the south. Following the conclusion of the strike the Kaiserreich agrees to the Hydronian ceasefire offer.[/spoiler]

Some of the executives starting losing confidence, this is a incredibly important event for WMW corporate. If this meeting were to go well, the corporation could make profits of billions. But the executives know that the weapons that will be made for [nation]Technokratisches Kaiserreich[/nation] will be used against other people in [nation]United Hydronia[/nation] or any nation at war with the Kaiserreich. Most of the executives just ignore this thought, or drown it with alcohol. (Which is very common in the WMW Board of Directors) But they will have to ignore it till after the meeting. The cars started driving to Büdingen, where they will meet with the Kaiser and discuss business.[/quote]
[i]The convoy of state cars take the group of men onto the imperial highway system. The path north to Büdingen has been completely cleared by the police allowing the car to quickly make its way towards the summer palace. After peeling off the highway at exit 55, the large paved roads quickly give way to smaller ones that lead in-between pastures. Along the way, through the bulletproof windows of the limousine the executives can see the Kaiserreichs countryside, dotted with farmhouses and large fields of corn and soybean. In a short while they are stopped at a large metal gate as armed men inspect the undersides of the vehicle and the driver provides identification. Soon they are cleared and now the lone limousine moves forward with the rest of the convoy staying behind. Making its way through a vast spruce forest, the massive Imperial Summer Palace appears before the men, its Baroque style preserved since its construction in 1844. 

As the limousine pulls into the drive, a welcoming party of statesmen and generals approach the automobile. Lining the drive are members of the Guard Korps in full traditional uniform. Once Wolff exits the vehicle, the Chairman of the Central Military Commission, General Sturmfels shakes his hand. 

Welcome to Büdingen Mr. Wolff.[/i]

[spoiler=[b]Prelude[/b]]
With the capture of Aduab by THEP forces, Sal-Baliz was essentially out of urban centers - They no longer could reliably draft its population to fight in the holy war. This did not mean that Sal-Baliz was entirely undefended and syphoned of resources, many industrial centers remained intact, and dedicated all of their efforts to fuel the decaying Sal-Baliz war machine. Al-Sharwa was amongst these industrial centers, located south of Aduab. Al-Sharwa was a mostly flat desert, with occasional rocky hills and mountains dotting the landscape, and several veins of rivers cut through the south of the region - Al-Sharwa is also the origin point of prehistoric kingdoms of the area, featuring ziggurats and the like. The survivors of the fall of Aduab, including the supreme leader himself, rushed to meet their allies waiting in Al-Sharwa. Elevated regions, and vital zones were fortified and occupied by Sal-Baliz forces, who were determined to cause as much damage as possible to the invading Hydronians.

High command tasked the 3rd Turvek assault unit to secure the region, solidifying THEPs foothold in Aduab and cutting off vital industry from Sal-Baliz. The 2nd Yorgulun was busy in maintaining the occupation of Aduab, but the Hydronian command was confident in 3rd Turveks abilities to take the region. On 1st of August, the assault on Al-Sharwa had begun. 
[/spoiler]

[spoiler=[b]Battle[/b]]
Hydronian High Command designated several vital points in Al-Sharwa. The urban settlement of Bazeyr, defended entirely by infantry, with several layers of trenchworks built facing west, where the Hydronians would come from. Helicopters and jets patrolled the skies, searching for Sal-Baliz armored columns and defenses. The 17th Armored Division advanced to assault Bazeyr, their ATGV-18Bs being the spearhead, followed by Otokars APCs. Infantry jumped into the trenches, clearing them out while the armor advanced. One by one, the layers fell, until Hydronia reached the town proper. Otokars took the lead, followed closely by infantry - A whack-the-mole type of conflict started, with Sal-Baliz forces trying to take out Otokars before they saw them, and vice-versa. Eventually, after only half an hour of combat, the town's police station fell to Hydronia, following the town's hall, resulting in the total capitulation of Bazeyr's defenders - Next on the list was the oil refinery and the oil fields, and before the Hydronians could even reach it, the two facilities were desperately demolished by Sal-Baliz. The oil lit up, and pyres of black smoke filled the horizon. Dismissing concerns from the soldiers, Hydronian High Command ordered their troops to engage the retreating Sal-Baliz. The smoke blocked the tank's normal view, and the fire turned certain spots practically impossible to be analyzed visually with thermal vision. Tank squadrons of the 17th, 16th and 13th Armored Divisions assumed overwatch positions around the fire, gunning down any Sal-Baliz force that left the smoke and fire, jets roamed the air, landing missiles into any armored column that they could find. Hydronian forces made one last sweep of the area by nightfall, and although the soldiers were already exhausted by this point, Military Command ordered the offensive to continue through the night. The Hydronian soldiers pushed themselves, taking more and more towns in the Al-Sharwa area, facing several ambushes amd layers of trenchworks. By morning, the Hydronians reached the ziggurats of Al-Sharwa.
Hydronian infantry, protected by the armor of Otokars, advanced to the sloped walls of the ancient temples, flushing into its courtyards, cleaning the surface before heading to secure the zigurrat's catacombs. Sal-Baliz placed artillery pieces, machine guns and anti-tank cannons on top of the walls, halting the advance of the tanks and Otokars until air support could come in and disable the guns. By mid-day, most of Al-Sharwa was secured, with the execption of a small pocket of Sal-Baliz armored squadrons down east - A extensive muddy marshland, created by the flooding of the several rivers in the region, stood between Hydronia and the Sal-Baliz. Almost all of the 3rd Turvek took part in the advance - The main battle tanks, followed by Otokars, trailed the most solid paths in the mud, under the cover of artillery and helicopters. Though some of the tanks eventually got stuck in the mud, the superior armor of the ATGV-18B allowed the tank to resist several shots from the older Sal-Baliz tanks - The Otokars had less luck, and several were destroyed before they could reach enemy lines. The surviving crews of the stuck vehicles were simply left behind to be rescued after the battle ended. Hydronian soldiers jumped from their vehicles when they reached the enemy trenches, fighting in intense close quarters combat, going trench by trench and bunker by bunker while the MBTs and the helicopters finished off what remained of the Sal-Baliz armor.

After searching the trenches through, the Hydronians came across a small bunker. Inside, Supreme leader Madhi Falah hidden behind a large ammo box. He opened fire on the troops, but they quickly surrounded him and shot him in the, making him immobile. The struggling leader would then be injected with an incapacitating agent and transported to a military camp, where he will be kept until THEP makes a further decision. 

By sunset, almost all enemy presence in Al-Sharwa was cleared out, and the battle was considered a great victory by Hydronian Command - Now, nothing can challenge the THEP rule over Sal-Baliz territory. The Hydronians have captured the east and the Bobians have the west. Throughout the next week, units will be deployed to capture smaller settlements and draw any remaining troops out of hiding.
